l4_steps.name: Extract sales transactions from PSS and GDS feeds
l4_steps.input: Daily booking, ticketing, and revenue transactions from Altéa
l4_steps.output: Raw sales transaction file (PNR, fare basis, channel, O&D)
l4_steps.kpi: Data extraction completeness ≥99.5% of daily transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa feed latency can delay T+1 reporting; GDS interline sales require separate reconciliation from Sabre and Travelport settlement files

l4_steps.name: Ingest GDS booking and yield data via settlement files
l4_steps.input: Sabre PRISM BSP settlement files and Travelport agency booking reports
l4_steps.output: Consolidated GDS channel dataset with agency, fare, and yield fields
l4_steps.kpi: GDS data ingestion within 4 hours of BSP file receipt
l4_steps.pain_point: Sabre PRISM and Travelport use different file formats requiring dual ETL pipelines; mismatched PNR cross-references cause ~2% of records to fail automatic join

l4_steps.name: Validate data quality and apply cleansing rules
l4_steps.input: Raw PSS and GDS transaction datasets
l4_steps.output: Quality-scored dataset; rejected records quarantine file
l4_steps.kpi: Data quality score ≥98% (nulls, duplicates, invalid fare codes <2%)
l4_steps.pain_point: ATPCO fare basis code changes not always reflected in Altéa within same reporting cycle, causing mis-classification of fare families

l4_steps.name: Load cleansed data to analytics data warehouse
l4_steps.input: Validated and cleansed sales transaction dataset
l4_steps.output: Populated sales_fact and channel_dim tables in Redshift
l4_steps.kpi: Load completion within 2 hours of data quality sign-off; zero load failures
l4_steps.pain_point: Redshift cluster contention during concurrent ETL and BI query windows causes load job timeouts; workload management (WLM) tuning needed per reporting cycle

l4_steps.name: Configure KPI targets and alert thresholds in BI platform
l4_steps.input: Annual commercial plan targets (revenue, load factor, yield by route/channel)
l4_steps.output: Configured KPI thresholds and RAG alert rules in Tableau
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of approved KPI targets loaded before reporting cycle open
l4_steps.pain_point: Mid-year target revisions require manual threshold updates across multiple Tableau workbooks; no automated sync from SAP S/4HANA budget module

l4_steps.name: Build channel and revenue performance dashboards
l4_steps.input: Redshift sales_fact tables; KPI threshold configuration
l4_steps.output: Channel performance dashboard (GDS, NDC, direct, corporate) and revenue dashboard
l4_steps.kpi: Dashboard refresh latency ≤15 minutes from data load completion
l4_steps.pain_point: NDC API Gateway booking data lacks full itinerary detail compared to GDS PNRs, creating reporting asymmetry between channels that distorts yield comparisons

l4_steps.name: Validate dashboard figures against source system totals
l4_steps.input: Tableau dashboard revenue totals; SAP AR revenue recognition ledger
l4_steps.output: Reconciliation sign-off report; variance log if delta >0.5%
l4_steps.kpi: Dashboard-to-SAP revenue variance ≤0.5% before stakeholder distribution
l4_steps.pain_point: BSP settlement timing differences mean Altéa ticketing revenue and SAP AR recognised revenue diverge by up to 3 days, complicating same-day reconciliation

l4_steps.name: Analyse GDS channel yield and cost-per-booking
l4_steps.input: GDS segment dataset; published GDS booking fee schedule
l4_steps.output: Cost-per-booking report by GDS (Sabre / Travelport / Amadeus) and market
l4_steps.kpi: GDS net yield ≥$0.08/RPM after distribution cost deduction
l4_steps.pain_point: GDS incentive overrides negotiated per agency are not always reflected in PRISM reporting, causing under-reporting of true distribution cost by up to 12%

l4_steps.name: Assess NDC and direct channel conversion rates
l4_steps.input: NDC API search-to-book funnel data; direct website booking data
l4_steps.output: NDC/direct conversion funnel report with drop-off analysis
l4_steps.kpi: NDC channel conversion rate ≥2.8%; direct web conversion ≥4.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: NDC API Gateway does not expose abandoned search data uniformly across aggregators, making full-funnel attribution incomplete for ~30% of NDC traffic

l4_steps.name: Review corporate and TMC account performance vs contract
l4_steps.input: Sabre PRISM corporate account booking volumes; contracted revenue commitments
l4_steps.output: Corporate account scorecard; list of accounts below commitment threshold
l4_steps.kpi: ≥90% of corporate accounts at or above 80% of contracted volume target
l4_steps.pain_point: PRISM reporting lag of 48–72 hours means corporate account shortfalls are identified too late in the quarter for proactive remediation conversations with TMCs

l4_steps.name: Analyse fare class mix and RASK by route and market
l4_steps.input: Closed booking data by fare basis and O&D from Altéa NRM
l4_steps.output: Fare mix report: premium vs discount share, RASK by route
l4_steps.kpi: Average RASK ≥$0.145; premium fare class share ≥22% of total revenue
l4_steps.pain_point: NRM O&D attribution for multi-segment itineraries uses pro-rate allocation that diverges from finance segment-level revenue, creating dual versions of RASK truth

l4_steps.name: Monitor load factor and yield trends vs prior year
l4_steps.input: Current period and prior year sales_fact data from Redshift
l4_steps.output: Load factor and yield trend report; YoY variance by route, season, and channel
l4_steps.kpi: Load factor ≥83%; yield variance to prior year within ±5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Seasonal schedule changes (IATA SSIM S/W schedule swaps) cause route-level YoY comparisons to be distorted when new routes replace discontinued ones mid-period

l4_steps.name: Identify routes and segments below revenue performance target
l4_steps.input: RASK and load factor report; network revenue target thresholds from commercial plan
l4_steps.output: Underperformance flag list: routes with RASK <target for ≥2 consecutive periods
l4_steps.kpi: Zero routes with RASK <80% of target unaddressed beyond two consecutive reporting cycles
l4_steps.pain_point: Thin O&D markets with <10 daily passengers produce statistically unreliable RASK readings; automated flags generate false positives requiring manual analyst review

l4_steps.name: Produce budget variance and forecast deviation analysis
l4_steps.input: Actuals from SAP AR; approved budget and rolling forecast from SAP CO
l4_steps.output: Variance analysis pack: actual vs budget vs forecast by revenue line
l4_steps.kpi: Variance commentary complete for all lines deviating >±3% from budget
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP CO rolling forecast is updated monthly while sales actuals close weekly, creating a structural lag that makes mid-month variance analysis unreliable for operational decisions

l4_steps.name: Compile executive management reporting pack
l4_steps.input: Channel performance, fare mix, RASK, load factor, and variance reports
l4_steps.output: Monthly sales performance deck with KPI scorecards and narrative commentary
l4_steps.kpi: Management pack distributed by business day 5 of the following month
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual consolidation from multiple source reports (Tableau, SAP, PRISM) into a single Power BI pack introduces transcription risk and is a single-point-of-failure if the analyst is absent

l4_steps.name: Assess exceptions and determine escalation requirement
l4_steps.input: Management reporting pack; KPI RAG status from Tableau
l4_steps.output: Escalation decision: confirmed exception list for board or commercial committee
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of Red-rated KPIs reviewed within 24 hours of report distribution
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated linkage between Tableau RAG alerts and calendar invites or escalation workflows; exception follow-through depends on manual distribution list hygiene

l4_steps.name: Distribute reports and archive reporting cycle artefacts
l4_steps.input: Final approved management pack and all source reports
l4_steps.output: Reports distributed to stakeholders; artefacts archived in S3 with version tag
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of reports archived within 1 business day; distribution list accuracy ≥99%
l4_steps.pain_point: No single authoritative distribution list; stale email groups cause reports to reach departed employees or miss new regional sales directors after org changes
